presentation.title: RV2V Task 394 Gate C — Synchronized Stereo RGB to Disparity Visualization
presentation.task_summary: Promote the audited 862-sample DSEC Final set: synchronized left/right RGB establishes stereo geometry and Target visualizes official image-view disparity on one fixed scale.
presentation.review_question: Across this coverage-backed Final set, are left Input and right Reference synchronized stereo views, and is Target the frame-aligned official-disparity visualization with a stable Turbo scale and black invalid pixels?
